common_safety_invariant: Information-value gating may suppress acquisition only for optional/detail information. If unresolved personal information is a hard precondition for personalized action safety or boundedness, retrieval or generic answerability cannot satisfy/demote it; preserve necessary ASK when resolvable, otherwise use safe non-personalized bounded fallback.

candidates.root_cause: Hard safety dependencies are not authoritative end-to-end; unresolved required state can be deferred/softened and an answer selected after evidence acquisition.
candidates.general_invariant: Only optional/detail acquisition is value-gated; hard safety facts remain unsatisfied until that exact user-state dependency is satisfied or a defined safe fallback is selected.
candidates.expected_behavior: Independent evidence retrieval proceeds; necessary ASK remains; if unavailable/already asked, block personalization and provide bounded general answer.
candidates.regression_risk: Over-classification could cause unnecessary ASK or blocking.

candidates.root_cause: Answer context does not reliably gate individualized actions on unresolved personal-state dependencies distinct from evidence dependencies.
candidates.general_invariant: Evidence supports general claims only; it cannot satisfy a personal-fact dependency. Missing required personalization state bars individualized action in final answer context.
candidates.expected_behavior: Permit grounded general information after retrieval, but remove/block personalized actions until personal dependency is validated.
candidates.regression_risk: Projection-only enforcement may mask upstream dependency omissions; keep upstream checks too.
